## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set and second-model agreement [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 98%, Normal 2% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.997 / 76th percentile | Input not suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Models agree |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Benign | Mostly agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 3, 4) · ↓ invasive · Prominent; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Prominent; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules** (regions 4, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Largest contribution, yet spot check 0/20 [F2] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Scored below typical, so it lowers the concept score · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules and mitoses are Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3) is present; the reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- Normal vs Benign: neighbor BACH_0207 is Normal (similarity 0.91), though Normal probability is 2%.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 8, 9:** Confirm two-layered lobular epithelium; its spot check was 0/20.
2. **Regions 2, 10, 11:** Verify gland architecture is benign.
3. **Region 6:** Only region leaning invasive (+0.08 logit); the necrosis cue there is Unreliable.
